{{Quote|And there is another concern on the horizon. There has been a point-two percent reduction in tourism revenue on Garqi.|Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum|<ref name="The Living Force" />}}
'''Garqi''' was a terrestrial<ref name="The Living Force" /> astronomical object in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TFABG" /> and [[New Territories]].<ref name="New Territories" /> Located on the [[Braxant Run]] [[hyperspace route]],<ref name="Braxant" /> it was situated at grid square K-5 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="TFABG" /> Garqi produced [[caf]], with the caf plant sector acting as a supply of tourism in the off season.<ref name="The Living Force" />

In [[33 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{LivingForceDate}}</ref> labor action took place in Garqi's caf plant sector. Tourism revenue on Garqi saw a reduction of point-two percent—more than what was predicted by models—with an economic working group headed by [[Senator]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] theorizing that it was a result of the labor action. [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] and Palpatine presented the issue in a meeting with [[Jedi Master]]s [[Adi Gallia]] and [[Yoda]]. Gallia realized that Valorum was suggesting the [[Jedi Order]] send [[Jedi Knight]]s to assist in the negotiations; the chancellor sarcastically remarked that the alternative of sending them on holiday would not help before moving on to another matter.<ref name="The Living Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Garqi was first mentioned on a map included in the [[2016]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] boxed set [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]].<ref name="TFABG" />
